_about: How LTEC holds a deal. A template builds the deal's warehouse (vehicle) inputs from the deal's check (investor.check) and the vehicle close date, with LTEC's partners. Applied by apply_structure (core.py) / applyStructure (core.js), or scripts/apply_structure.py. Amounts in a template are fractions of the check (reserve_pct, manager_commitment_pct); everything else is copied. Defaults follow SV26 (Siena, Nov 3 memo) as LTEC's precedent; change them here to change the house terms.

direct.label: Direct: LTEC invests
direct.note: LTEC itself writes the check into the deal. No SPV, no SPV fees or promote. LTEC's partners own LTEC by their capital, and LTEC's terms between its partners apply.

spv.label: SPV, fully subscribed
spv.note: An SPV invests the check; LTEC commits part of it and manages it, outside members put in the rest at close. LTEC earns an acquisition fee and a promote above the members' hurdle.

spv_warehouse.label: SPV with warehouse & sell-down (SV26-style)
spv_warehouse.note: As the fully subscribed SPV, but the lead partner funds the outside share at close (warehouses it) and sells it to new members six months later at par plus 6% simple carry.
